question: Gugga is the famous ritualistic dance of ________, which is performed in the procession taken out in memory of Gugga Pir.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gugga** is a famous ritualistic dance performed in the state of **Haryana**.
 
• This dance is specifically performed during the procession taken out in memory of **Gugga Pir**.
 
• Gugga Pir is a revered figure, and the dance is an integral part of the cultural and religious practices in certain regions of Haryana.
 
• The procession and dance reflect the local traditions and the community's devotion to Gugga Pir.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gugga Pir** is also known as **Gugga Jaharpir** in some regions, and he is considered a warrior saint.
 
• The dance is typically performed during the **Gugga Naumi** festival, which falls in the monsoon season.
 
• The festival and dance serve as a means to seek blessings and protection from Gugga Pir against snake bites and other misfortunes.
 
• Haryana's cultural landscape is rich with such traditional dances and rituals that are deeply rooted in the local folklore and religious beliefs.
